design_philosophy: Linear/Notion-like aesthetic. Emphasizes structure, typography-driven hierarchy, and generous negative space. Cardless or flat-bordered UI without drop shadows to keep the interface highly functional and editorial. The accent color evokes travel and earthiness without resorting to standard tech blues or purples.

typography.setup_instructions: Import Cabinet Grotesk and Satoshi via Fontshare or local assets. Import JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision. Use a 12-column bento grid for the dashboard layout.
spacing_and_layout.shadows: DO NOT use drop shadows for depth. Rely on 1px borders (border border-neutral-200) and white backgrounds to separate elements.

buttons.primary: bg-[#DE6242] text-white hover:bg-[#C85335] rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-neutral-200 text-neutral-900 hover:bg-neutral-50 rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-neutral-100 text-neutral-600 hover:text-neutral-900 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-colors

cards.default: bg-white border border-neutral-200 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-none

inputs.default: bg-white border border-neutral-200 rounded-md px-3 py-2 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#DE6242]/20 focus:border-[#DE6242] outline-none transition-all shadow-sm

timeline_itinerary.dot: absolute w-3 h-3 bg-[#DE6242] rounded-full -left-[6.5px] top-1.5 ring-4 ring-white
timeline_itinerary.title: text-lg font-semibold text-neutral-900

budget_tracker.header_cell: border-b border-neutral-200 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-500

packing_list.item: flex items-center gap-3 p-3 hover:bg-neutral-50 rounded-lg transition-colors border border-transparent hover:border-neutral-100
packing_list.checkbox: w-5 h-5 rounded border border-neutral-300 text-[#DE6242] focus:ring-[#DE6242]

hero_abstract.description: Abstract topographic map with rough textures and smooth water. Use as a subtle background for the hero section or empty states.

feature_architecture.description: Modern building with arched balconies and blue sky.

feature_road_map.description: A winding road in the middle of a lush green forest.

feature_planning.description: Minimalist workspace with an open notebook, pen, and laptop.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must have a distinct hover state. Use subtle background shifts (e.g., hover:bg-neutral-50) rather than scale transforms to keep the UI feeling rigid and professional.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Minimalist fade-ins. Avoid heavy sliding animations.
motion_and_interactions.modals: Fade in with a slight upward drift (translate-y-2 to translate-y-0).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly avoid the 'Inter' font. Follow the typography setup carefully.
Do NOT use drop shadows on cards (no shadow-md or shadow-lg). Instead, use border border-neutral-200 and solid white backgrounds.
Use lucide-react for all icons, keeping a stroke width of 1.5 for a sophisticated look.
For the Map View feature, embed a cleanly styled map (e.g., Mapbox or Google Maps with a minimal/silver styling) inside a bordered container with rounded-xl.
Implement Shadcn UI extensively but override default styles to remove box shadows and enforce 1px borders.
Ensure all user-facing monetary values and times use the font-mono class for precise alignment.
